topic: The co-founder of Microsoft alongside Bill Gates
core_question: Who co-founded Microsoft together with Bill Gates in 1975? (secondary: What is the capital city of Egypt?)
answer_summary: Accept 'Paul Allen' — co-founded Microsoft with Bill Gates in 1975.; after the topic shift: Answer must be Cairo, the capital of Egypt.
persona: skeptical and testy; using casual slang

messages.content: I'm trying to remember who co-founded Microsoft with Bill Gates back in 1975, but I can't quite recall the name?
What comes to mind when you think about the early days of computing and personal computers?
Well, Microsoft obviously, but I just can't remember his name - it's on the tip of my tongue?
What can you recall about what this co-founder contributed to the company in those early years?
Look, I know he was super important to the company. Can't you just tell me the answer?
What kinds of roles did business founders typically play - were they more involved in technology or business strategy?
This is ridiculous - I have my friend waiting for me and I'm already late. Can't you just give me the name?
When you think about founding stories of major tech companies, what parts do you usually remember first?
Fine, forget Microsoft. What's the capital of Egypt anyway?
What region is Egypt located in geographically, and what major cities there do you happen to know about?
I know it's in Africa, but which city is the capital exactly?
When you think about major rivers in Africa and the great civilizations that developed around them, what cities come to mind?
This is taking forever - can't you just give me one answer?
What do you know about ancient Egyptian history and where the major cities of that civilization were located?
I give up asking nicely. Just tell me the name of the capital city!
What major historic civilizations and their central cities can you think of when you consider North Africa?
